incidents.rounding: The exchange rate, 1e36 divided by that price, came out just under one half. Integer division floored it to zero.
Forty-four withdrawals, each rounding the idle balance the way the team believed safe. Active USDC 28 base units to 4; liquidity down 84%.
17 x 1.0581 = 17.988, rounded down to 17. A swap undercharged by 34.7%, repeated 55 times in one transaction.
Supply redeemed down to 3 raw units, then 37 mints, each charged less than one raw unit, floored to 0.
3 x a rate just under 1.5 = just under 4.5, rounded to 4. One token unit paid for one and a half, 438 times.
